# Client { #crossrepo.github.Client }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client(auth=None, api=API)
```

A thin, streaming client for the parts of the GitHub API crossrepo needs.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**auth**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Token to authenticate with. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.github.token`).

<code>[**api**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [API]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Base address of the API, so a test can point this somewhere else.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
client = Client()
client.tree("munch-group", "tree-stats", "main")
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [commit](#crossrepo.github.Client.commit) | Read one commit. |
| [commits](#crossrepo.github.Client.commits) | List the commits that touched a path, newest first. |
| [default_branch](#crossrepo.github.Client.default_branch) | Find the branch a repository is read at by default. |
| [download_blob](#crossrepo.github.Client.download_blob) | Stream a blob to a file. |
| [get](#crossrepo.github.Client.get) | Fetch one JSON document. |
| [lfs_download](#crossrepo.github.Client.lfs_download) | Stream a Git LFS object to a file. |
| [paginate](#crossrepo.github.Client.paginate) | Fetch every page of a listing. |
| [read_blob](#crossrepo.github.Client.read_blob) | Read a blob into memory. |
| [repositories](#crossrepo.github.Client.repositories) | List the repositories an organisation or user owns. |
| [tree](#crossrepo.github.Client.tree) | List everything in a repository at a revision, in one request. |

### commit { #crossrepo.github.Client.commit }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.commit(owner, repo, ref)
```

Read one commit.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Branch, tag or commit sha. A branch gives the commit it points at, which is what stamps everything the repository publishes.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[dict](`dict`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The commit document, or `None` when there is no such revision.

### commits { #crossrepo.github.Client.commits }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.commits(owner, repo, path, limit=100)
```

List the commits that touched a path, newest first.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path of a file or directory.

<code>[**limit**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [100]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Most commits to return.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[dict](`dict`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Raw commit documents, newest first.

### download_blob { #crossrepo.github.Client.download_blob }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.download_blob(owner, repo, sha, dest)
```

Stream a blob to a file.

The content is copied straight from the socket to the file, so peak
memory does not grow with the size of the result.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Blob sha.

<code>[**dest**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File to write.

### get { #crossrepo.github.Client.get }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.get(endpoint, **params)
```

Fetch one JSON document.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**endpoint**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   API path, such as ``repos/owner/name/git/trees/main``. Named so rather than ``path`` because ``path`` is itself a query parameter GitHub takes, on the commits endpoint among others.

<code>[****params**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Any](`typing.Any`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [{}]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Query parameters.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Any](`typing.Any`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The decoded document.

### lfs_download { #crossrepo.github.Client.lfs_download }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.lfs_download(owner, repo, oid, size, dest)
```

Stream a Git LFS object to a file.

LFS content is not in the git tree — the tree holds a pointer — so it is
asked for through the batch endpoint, which hands back a URL to fetch it
from.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**oid**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The sha256 object id from the pointer file.

<code>[**size**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Size of the real content, from the pointer file.

<code>[**dest**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File to write.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[GitHubError](`crossrepo.github.GitHubError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the batch endpoint refuses, or names no download for the object.

### paginate { #crossrepo.github.Client.paginate }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.paginate(endpoint, **params)
```

Fetch every page of a listing.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**endpoint**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   API path returning a JSON array.

<code>[****params**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Any](`typing.Any`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [{}]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Query parameters. ``per_page`` defaults to the maximum of 100.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Iterator](`typing.Iterator`)\[[dict](`dict`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An iterator over every item, across all pages. Pages are fetched as it is consumed, so stopping early stops requesting.

### read_blob { #crossrepo.github.Client.read_blob }

```python
crossrepo.github.Client.read_blob(owner, repo, sha)
```

Read a blob into memory.

Only for content known to be small, such as a manifest or a Git LFS
pointer. Use [](`crossrepo.github.Client.download_blob`) for result files.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Blob sha.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bytes](`bytes`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The raw content.

List everything in a repository at a revision, in one request.
